name: issuekeymetrics

queries.label: compareissues
queries.sql_text:
SELECT
    :compareFrom AS query_from,
    :compareTo AS query_to,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(i.original_project, ''), b.name) AS original_project,
    i.created_date, i.updated_date, i.resolution_date, i.status,
    i.issue_key, i.url, MAX(i.type) AS type, i.epic_key, i.title,
    i.description, i.priority, i.creator_name, i.assignee_name,
    i.severity, i.component, i.urgency, i.is_subtask,
    i.due_date, i.fix_versions, i.story_point
FROM devlake.issues i
JOIN devlake.board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN devlake.boards b ON b.id = bi.board_id
WHERE bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM JSON_TABLE(:boardScopes, '$[*]' COLUMNS (
      project_key VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_key',
      project_name VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.project_name',
      board_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.board_id',
      connection_id VARCHAR(128) PATH '$.connection_id'
    )) AS selected_scope
    WHERE ((selected_scope.project_key <> '' AND selected_scope.project_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1))
      OR (selected_scope.project_name <> '' AND selected_scope.project_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = i.original_project))
      AND (selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.board_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(bi.board_id, ':', -1))
      AND (selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = '' OR selected_scope.connection_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(bi.board_id, ':', 3), ':', -1))
  )
  AND
    :hasCompare = 1
    AND (:hasIssueScope = 1 AND (i.original_project IN (:projectNames) OR SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.issue_key, '-', 1) IN (:projectKeys)))
    AND (:hasUserwhitelist = 0 OR i.assignee_name IN (:userwhitelist))
    AND (
        i.status = 'TODO' OR i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
        OR (
            i.resolution_date IS NOT NULL
            AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) >= :compareFrom
            AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(i.resolution_date) <= :compareTo
        )
    )
GROUP BY i.issue_key, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.original_project, ''), b.name),
    i.created_date, i.updated_date, i.resolution_date, i.status, i.url,
    i.epic_key, i.title, i.description, i.priority, i.creator_name,
    i.assignee_name, i.severity, i.component, i.urgency, i.is_subtask,
    i.due_date, i.fix_versions, i.story_point
